qpu_time_ms.source: Manuscript Table 11 (mean +/- SD, per-circuit QPU time)

timing_scope.execution_time_s: Total IBM Quantum Runtime / IonQ job execution phase for the whole evaluation run for this case study (all circuits / COBYLA iterations / kernel batches, transpilation, classical pre/post-processing and readout-error mitigation). NOT a single-circuit time.
timing_scope.qpu_time_ms: Mean per-circuit QPU execution time from Table 11. Excludes queueing, network, encoding, mitigation and classical post-processing.
timing_scope.queue_time_s: Time the job spent queued before execution.
timing_scope.other_overhead_s: Wall-clock time not accounted for by queue_time_s + execution_time_s (provider-side result retrieval / post-processing). 0 for 4 of 5 jobs; 100 s for the drug-target job — see hardware/TIMING.md.
timing_scope.wall_clock_s: completed - submitted, in seconds. wall_clock_s = queue_time_s + execution_time_s + other_overhead_s by construction.
